category: Configure Compilation, Interpreter, and Build Processes to Improve Executable Security (PW)
subcategory_text: Pin toolchain and dependency versions in the build to ensure reproducibility and prevent supply-chain surprises.
implementation_examples: Pin package versions via lockfiles (package-lock.json, poetry.lock, Pipfile.lock, go.sum)
Use pinned Docker base images with digest references
Verify integrity via checksums or signatures on dependency downloads
assessment_objectives: Determine whether dependencies are pinned with verified integrity.
Determine whether toolchain versions are pinned and reproducible.
